Patients and front_desk users fall through with no authorization check, so any logged-in patient can edit ANY prescription (changing medication_name, dosage, instructions, quantity, and even the patient assignment via PrescriptionForm). Unlike prescription_create, there is no is_clinician/is_clinic_admin role gate.
